_readme: S484 SkyToyon, 2026-10-26. Hartnell's eight noncredit programs (measure hours) list courses with no hours, so their arithmetic reads incomplete. The Requirements tab's scripts POST courses/search to app.coursedog.com and each course object carries its hours (handoff 458: lectureHours and labHours), past the 1,500 characters the reader prints of a body. This read loads two noncredit Requirements tabs and prints the stretch of each answer around the hours fields and the course codes, to learn their shape before a reconcile kind reads them. Two tabs, no model call.

outside_hosts.coursedog.com: Hartnell's catalog vendor hosts the catalog itself (hartnell.catalog.prod.coursedog.com) and its data (app.coursedog.com); the registry's catalog address is on this host.

questions.course_hours: The shape of each course's hours in the courses/search answer (lectureHours, labHours, any total or contact hours), and whether ENGM 620 and 622's hours sum to the program's 216 and BUS 650, 660, 690 and 699's to 432.
